services.desc: Celebrate with the Creative Arts Community as the Art in Menucha program-a summer arts camp for adults-turns 60. Assorted pieces by instructors, members, and founders. LOSD art teachers Micah Malone, Katherine Brink, and Amy Burnham selected works from their AP Art classes for inclusion. Student 2D and 3D works from Lakeridge and Lake Oswego High Schools were displayed. Unexpected ceramics by 7 local artists; James Alby, Ben Killen Rosenberg, Marjorie Dial, Ben Skiba, Lisa Conway, Nick Norman, and ahuva s zaslavsky Megita Denton, Bobby Mercier, Leroy Setziol, Monica Setziol-Phillips, Julian Watts, Ben Young, and Adam

blurb: The Arts Council of Lake Oswego is a women-led, nonprofit visual arts organization that provides access to free public art exhibitions and educational programs in Artspace Gallery and manages Lake Oswego's public art collections.
